The background is slightly blurred, suggesting a busy environment with people moving around, though their details are indistinct due to the shallow depth of field. caption: The video captures a close-up, static view of a circular metal plate fitted with short dark nozzles, from which many thin transparent liquid threads hang straight down and exit the bottom of the frame. Many threads hold a bulbous droplet near their upper end, while smaller bulges appear along several vertical lines. These discrete droplets and bulges translate downward along the hanging threads, including a prominent teardrop on the right and a droplet on the left. The plate and nozzles remain fixed, and the threads keep their vertical geometry without visible sideways movement. The upper bulbs near the nozzles stay roughly constant in size and position while lower portions continue out of view. A blurred figure in dark blue clothing and out-of-focus hands appear behind the apparatus. The visible process is ongoing throughout, with no detachment or pooling shown within the frame.

a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
